## ✨ New in 0.3.1

**Fixes from the first tries on Windows 11.**

- 🎮 **Windows:** a new run no longer closes the game as Kirby appears, and an Xbox controller works with Steam's overlay on.
- 🛗 **Smoother on fast screens:** on screens faster than 60 Hz (such as 75 Hz), Kirby moves evenly and stays on elevators while they move.
- 🖱️ **The launcher:** every button answers the first click, and you can move through it with a controller: the D-pad or stick to choose, **A** to press, **B** to go back.
- 👣 **Everywhere:** Kirby and his helper now stand on wooden planks and stone ledges instead of just above them.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **The Windows version is still a test.** These fixes were played on a Windows 11 PC, but this download has not been tried there yet. If you try it, please [tell us how it went](https://github.com/NahuelGenchi/kirbys-dead-land/issues/new), whether it works or not.
